scope: Two disjoint128-record assignments; every saved abstract string read in full. One source string (MED32703928) is itself truncated upstream and remains explicitly incomplete. Source/ID records include reviews, preprints and publication versions, not independent drug experiments or full-text appraisals. Historical flags remain unchanged by separate primary follow-up.

records.title: Reducing the aneuploid cell burden - cell competition and the ribosome connection.
records.model: Aneuploid cells; Drosophila competition and mammalian embryos
records.note: Discusses ribosomal gene dosage as a potential recognition signal for selective aneuploid-cell elimination. No administered intervention or measured tissue replacement is presented.
records.uncertainty: Mammalian ribosomal-dose recognition remains unresolved in the abstract.

records.title: Individualized drug screening based on next generation sequencing and patient derived xenograft model for pancreatic cancer with bone metastasis.
records.model: Patient-derived pancreatic bone-metastasis xenograft
records.note: Sequencing nominated AZD6244 and the PDX response was reported as effective. The endpoint concerns suppression of an established cancer, not restoration of normal tissue function.
records.uncertainty: Magnitude, toxicity and patient response are not specified.

records.title: Integrative epitranscriptomic and transcriptomic characterization in human colorectal cancer.
records.model: Human colorectal tumors and SIM2-silenced xenografts
records.note: Integrative methylation analyses nominated SIM2; silencing reduced tumor growth. This is genetic tumor-target validation, not an administered restoration medicine.
records.uncertainty: No named drug or normal-tissue functional rescue.

records.title: Analysis of the Progeny of Sibling Matings Reveals Regulatory Variation Impacting the Transcriptome of Immune Cells in Commercial Chickens.
records.model: Inbred commercial chicken F2 progeny and macrophages
records.note: Sibling mating exposed large immune-transcript variation; most families lacked overt developmental harm. LPS was an experimental stimulus rather than treatment of an inherited defect.
records.uncertainty: Expression differences do not establish therapeutic restoration.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint silencing: ensuring rapid and concerted anaphase onset.
records.model: Spindle checkpoint and anaphase regulation
records.note: Reviews checkpoint silencing and concerted anaphase onset. No administered agent or restorative experiment is described.
records.uncertainty: Checkpoint release cannot be assumed to improve chromosome fidelity.

records.title: The end of mitosis from a phosphatase perspective.
records.model: Vertebrate mitotic phosphatases
records.note: Summarizes phosphatase-mediated reversal of mitotic phosphorylation. It identifies biological processes without a named administered intervention or tissue outcome.
records.uncertainty: No drug-rescue result in this abstract.

records.title: European guidelines for constitutional cytogenomic analysis.
records.model: Constitutional cytogenomic laboratories
records.note: Offers laboratory standards for cytogenomic diagnosis as technology changes. It does not evaluate a therapeutic intervention.
records.uncertainty: Diagnostic quality guidance is not efficacy evidence.

records.title: Integration of single-cell RNA-seq and bulk RNA-seq to construct liver hepatocellular carcinoma stem cell signatures to explore their impact on patient prognosis and treatment.
records.model: Public liver-cancer single-cell and bulk transcriptomes
records.note: A stemness-associated risk signature predicts survival and drug sensitivity computationally. No administered treatment experiment validates those predictions.
records.uncertainty: Predicted immunotherapy or chemotherapy benefit is not observed tissue rescue.

records.title: Female infertility in PDE3A(-/-) mice: polo-like kinase 1 (Plk1) may be a target of protein kinase A (PKA) and involved in meiotic arrest of oocytes from PDE3A(-/-) mice.

administered_agents.name: Rp-cAMPS
administered_agents.role: PKA inhibitor used in mutant oocytes

records.model: PDE3A-null murine oocytes; WT and biochemical comparisons
records.note: Rp-cAMPS reactivated Plk1 in arrested PDE3A-null oocytes, a named-agent correction of a protein-activity defect. The abstract does not report restored maturation, fertility or chromosome fidelity.
records.uncertainty: Primary details are needed to distinguish target reactivation from successful meiosis and assess agent specificity.

records.title: PKM2 regulates chromosome segregation and mitosis progression of tumor cells.
records.model: Tumor cells and glioblastoma specimens
records.note: PKM2-mediated Bub3 phosphorylation supports checkpoint recruitment, accurate segregation and tumor proliferation. This is a mechanistic protein axis, with tumorigenic consequences rather than a demonstrated medicine.
records.uncertainty: No administered restorative agent; direction cannot be transferred to PKM2 modulation generally.

records.title: Down-regulation of siglec-2 (CD22) predicts worse overall survival from HBV-related early-stage hepatocellular carcinoma: a preliminary analysis from Gene Expression Omnibus.
records.model: HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma cohorts
records.note: Higher siglec-2 expression correlated with better survival and lower AFP. The study did not therapeutically raise siglec-2 or measure restoration.
records.uncertainty: Association does not establish causality or a drug effect.

records.title: Identification of candidate genes and prognostic value analysis in patients with PDL1-positive and PDL1-negative lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: PDL1-positive and negative lung adenocarcinoma datasets
records.note: Differential expression and network analysis nominated prognostic genes and pathways. Anti-PD-1 therapy is background; no antibody experiment is reported.
records.uncertainty: Proposed regulatory mechanisms and treatment relevance require validation.

records.title: Transcriptomic Profile of Oral Cancer Lesions: A Proof-of-Concept Pilot Study of FFPE Tissue Sections.
records.model: Three oral-cancer FFPE samples versus six public breast-cancer samples
records.note: Pilot cross-cancer profiling found keratin and inflammatory-pathway differences. It contains no administered rescue or functional tissue comparison.
records.uncertainty: Small and biologically different comparison groups limit causal interpretation.

records.title: Differential regulation of centrosome integrity by DNA damage response proteins.
records.model: MDC1/BRIT1-depleted cells and breast-cancer associations
records.note: Depletion caused distinct centrosomal, segregation and cytokinesis defects, implicating negative regulation of Aurora A and Plk1. No pharmacologic correction is described.
records.uncertainty: Kinase association alone cannot nominate a restorative inhibitor.

records.title: Gene expression profiling and in vitro functional studies reveal RAD54L as a potential therapeutic target in multiple myeloma.
records.model: KMS-28BM myeloma cells and expression samples
records.note: RAD54L siRNA reduced growth and induced G0/G1 arrest with small apoptosis changes. This is tumor-cell gene silencing rather than improved mitotic fidelity.
records.uncertainty: No administered medicine or healthy tissue function.

records.title: Polyploid and Chromosomal Copy Number Gain Cells in Metastatic Colon Cancer: Exploratory Genotype-Phenotype Correlations.
records.model: Metastatic colon-cancer tissue cohort
records.note: Morphology, FISH and sequencing characterize polyploid/copy-gain tumors. No intervention reverses these states or improves functional output.
records.uncertainty: Exploratory associations do not establish a therapeutic route.

records.title: Prognostic significance of CKAP2L expression in patients with clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Clear-cell renal carcinoma cohorts and clinical tissues
records.note: CKAP2L elevation correlates with prognosis and immune infiltration; pathway roles are inferred. Expression validation does not constitute intervention efficacy.
records.uncertainty: No CKAP2L drug or functional rescue tested.

records.title: Radiosensitization in Pediatric High-Grade Glioma: Targets, Resistance and Developments.
records.model: Pediatric high-grade glioma radiosensitization literature
records.note: Reviews radiation-enhancement strategies while noting failure of preclinical approaches to improve clinical outcomes. No specific restorative agent is identified in this abstract.
records.uncertainty: Radiation symptom relief is background rather than a new efficacy experiment.

records.title: Dormancy exit correlates with CREB1 reactivation that is a potential target to overcome endocrine therapy resistance in ER<sup>+</sup> breast cancer cells.
records.model: ER-positive endocrine-resistant breast-cancer cells, PDXs and patient samples
records.note: CREB1 inhibition reduces survival of resistant cancer cells and shifts dormancy transcription. The inhibition method is unnamed, so pharmacologic identity cannot be assumed.
records.uncertainty: Aromatase and CDK4/6 inhibitors are background classes; no named therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Comparative Profiles of Pediatric Mendeliome: A Single-Center 572-Whole-Exome Sequencing Study in Xinjiang.
records.model: 572 pediatric suspected Mendelian-disorder cases
records.note: WES diagnoses influenced management and referrals. No particular medication or post-treatment functional improvement is reported.
records.uncertainty: Management change is not measured treatment efficacy.

records.title: Martini: using literature keywords to compare gene sets.
records.model: Gene-set benchmark datasets
records.note: Martini compares gene sets using literature keywords and performs well against other tools. This is an informatics benchmark, not an intervention study.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic inference from automated gene-function descriptions.

records.title: Emerging links among Chromosome Instability (CIN), cancer, and aging.
records.model: Chromosome-instability mouse models and aging literature
records.note: Discusses CIN, senescence, immune clearance and potential intervention points. No named administered agent or observed tissue restoration appears in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: Clearance mechanisms do not by themselves establish productive tissue renewal.

records.title: Application of <sup>212</sup>Pb for Targeted α-particle Therapy (TAT): Pre-clinical and Mechanistic Understanding through to Clinical Translation.

administered_agents.name: 212Pb-TCMC-trastuzumab
administered_agents.role: targeted alpha therapy discussed in clinical trial

records.model: Cancer models and ovarian-cancer phase I study
records.note: Review describes targeted radiation delivery and phase I feasibility. Destruction of targeted cancer cells is distinct from correcting chromosome instability in normal tissues.
records.uncertainty: No normal-tissue functional compensation outcome given.

records.title: Mitotic checkpoint control and chromatin remodeling.
records.model: Spindle checkpoints and chromatin remodeling
records.note: Connects Bub1/Sgo1 checkpoint functions to histone modification. No administered corrective intervention is described.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic overlap does not establish a medicine.

records.title: Identification of differentially expressed microRNAs in primary esophageal achalasia by next-generation sequencing.
records.model: Esophageal tissues from achalasia patients and controls
records.note: Altered miRNAs are linked to predicted neuronal and neuromuscular pathways. No miRNA intervention or restored motility was tested.
records.uncertainty: Predicted pathway involvement is not a functional treatment outcome.

records.title: Identification of the key genes controlling stomach adenocarcinoma stem cell characteristics via an analysis of stemness indices.
records.model: Stomach-adenocarcinoma expression datasets
records.note: Nineteen stemness-associated genes were nominated from coexpression and survival analyses. Cell-cycle enrichment does not supply a tested inhibitor or tissue rescue.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacologic validation reported.

records.title: Photodynamic therapy induced cell cycle arrest and cancer cell synchronization: review.
records.model: Cancer photodynamic-therapy literature
records.note: Reviews photosensitizer/light-induced arrest and multiple death pathways. Proposed ROS models and synchronization aim to improve tumor treatment, not faithful tissue renewal.
records.uncertainty: No named agent or restorative comparison in the abstract.

records.title: Kinesin-7 CENP-E regulates chromosome alignment and genome stability of spermatogenic cells.
records.model: Spermatogenic cells during spermatogenesis
records.note: CENP-E inhibition causes metaphase arrest, chromosome misalignment, aneuploid cells and impaired sperm-head/tail formation. This is a distinct tissue-level counterexample to restorative CENP-E inhibition.
records.uncertainty: Species, exposure, reversibility and actual fertility outcomes require primary verification.

records.title: Tension at EMBO's Aneuploidy Workshop.
records.model: EMBO chromosome-segregation workshop
records.note: Brief workshop report links basic mitotic mechanisms and aneuploid disease. It provides no agent-specific experiment or measurable rescue.
records.uncertainty: Insufficient intervention detail for nomination.

records.title: The Hippo Signaling Pathway in Cancer: A Cell Cycle Perspective.
records.model: Hippo signaling across model organisms and cancer
records.note: Reviews Hippo control of checkpoints, centrosomes and mitosis with cancer-treatment implications. No administered route or tissue compensation is identified.
records.uncertainty: Organ-size regulation is background, not a demonstrated regenerative treatment.

records.title: Post-translational modifications at the crossroads of cancer metabolism and immune regulation: therapeutic opportunities and challenges.
records.model: Cancer metabolism and immune regulation
records.note: Surveys six post-translational modification classes and targeting strategies. No named agent or measured restorative outcome is in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: PTM modulation cannot be assumed to raise a deficient checkpoint protein safely.

records.title: Kinase signaling in the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Spindle checkpoint kinases
records.note: Describes kinases that amplify checkpoint signals and correct attachments. No actual-agent intervention tests restoration.
records.uncertainty: Activity roles do not identify a therapeutic exposure.

records.title: Membrane Bound Peroxiredoxin-1 Serves as a Biomarker for In Vivo Detection of Sessile Serrated Adenomas.
records.model: BRAF-mutant cells and human serrated-adenoma specimens
records.note: Identifies surface Prdx1 as the imaging-peptide target associated with oxidative stress. Lesion detection is not Prdx1 restoration or therapeutic benefit.
records.uncertainty: No tissue repair or administered antioxidant outcome.

records.title: A functional role of RB-dependent pathway in the control of quiescence in adult epidermal stem cells revealed by genomic profiling.
records.model: Epidermis-specific Rb-null mice and adult hair-follicle stem cells
records.note: Hair regrowth and wound-healing experiments implicate Rb-E2F in stem-cell quiescence. These are useful tissue-function assays, but the abstract supplies neither a drug nor an explicit beneficial direction.
records.uncertainty: Genetic Rb loss cannot be treated as evidence for pharmacologic regenerative benefit.

records.title: Unraveling the Significance of EPH/Ephrin Signaling in Liver Cancer: Insights into Tumor Progression and Therapeutic Implications.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma EPH/ephrin signaling
records.note: Reviews growth, migration and invasion mechanisms as possible cancer targets. No named intervention or functional rescue is presented.
records.uncertainty: Target plausibility is not treatment efficacy.

records.title: Overlapping functional modules detection in PPI network with pair-wise constrained non-negative matrix tri-factorisation.
records.model: Synthetic and biological protein-interaction networks
records.note: PCNMTF improves discovery of overlapping functional modules. The work tests a network algorithm, not cell or tissue intervention.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic experiment.

records.title: CENP-W plays a role in maintaining bipolar spindle structure.
records.model: CENP-W-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: Monastrol reduced pole fragmentation after CENP-W depletion; reciprocal CENP-W RNAi increased bipolar spindles under monastrol. Separate TPX2 overexpression suppressed fragmentation, providing a distinct genetic comparator.
records.uncertainty: Need primary contrast directions, control harm and completed accurate-division outcomes; structural categories alone do not establish fidelity.

records.title: Spindly attachments.
records.model: Spindly/SPDL-1 kinetochore attachment study
records.note: Discusses a separate study of attachment and ploidy maintenance. No administered agent or rescue result is supplied.
records.uncertainty: Not a primary intervention experiment.

records.title: Housekeeping genes in prostate tumorigenesis.
records.model: Normal, localized and metastatic prostate tissue
records.note: Housekeeping-gene expression shifts include ribosomal and heat-shock changes across tumor stages. A proposed vulnerable stress window is not a tested treatment.
records.uncertainty: No agent-specific rescue or tumor response.

records.title: Multiple rare variants in high-risk pancreatic cancer-related genes may increase risk for pancreatic cancer in a subset of patients with and without germline CDKN2A mutations.
records.model: Pancreatic-cancer cases and controls with CDKN2A stratification
records.note: Rare variants in several pathways may compound pancreatic-cancer susceptibility. Sequencing does not evaluate correction or a compensating medicine.
records.uncertainty: Associations and variant predictions are not efficacy evidence.

records.title: No transcription, no problem: Protein phosphorylation changes and the transition from oocyte to embryo.
records.model: Animal egg activation and maternal proteomes
records.note: Reviews calcium-linked phosphorylation that drives meiosis completion and embryogenesis. These are physiological transitions rather than a reported deficient-oocyte treatment.
records.uncertainty: No administered regulator or rescue endpoint in the abstract.

records.title: Expression and Prognostic Role of E2F2 in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma datasets
records.note: E2F2 elevation associates with poor prognosis and immune infiltration. No therapeutic inhibition or restoration is experimentally tested.
records.uncertainty: Coexpression and inferred targets are not causal drug outcomes.

records.title: Analyses of MicroRNA and mRNA Expression Profiles Reveal the Crucial Interaction Networks and Pathways for Regulation of Chicken Breast Muscle Development.
records.model: Gushi chicken breast muscle at four postnatal ages
records.note: Constructs miRNA/mRNA networks for natural muscle development, including FoxO and cell-cycle nodes. Actual muscle tissue is profiled, but no treatment changes muscle function.
records.uncertainty: Network centrality is not evidence for a compensating agent.

records.title: Mitotic genes are transcriptionally upregulated in the fibroblast irradiated with very low doses of UV-C.
records.model: Human primary fibroblasts exposed to UV-C
records.note: Low UV-C exposure increased mitotic-gene transcripts. This is an irradiation stress response, not proof of safe checkpoint-protein restoration or faithful division.
records.uncertainty: Expression induction without functional fidelity or damage accounting.

records.title: Microtubule-dependent regulation of mitotic protein degradation.
records.model: Mitotic spindle assembly factors and APC/C substrates
records.note: Microtubule binding protects active spindle factors from APC/C degradation, supporting correct spindle function. No administered stabilizing agent is identified.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic preservation cannot be mapped to generalized proteasome blockade.

records.title: Pilomyxoid Astrocytoma (PMA) Shows Significant Differences in Gene Expression vs. Pilocytic Astrocytoma (PA) and Variable Tendency Toward Maturation to PA.
records.model: Pilomyxoid and pilocytic astrocytoma samples
records.note: Profiles tumor expression and describes heterogeneous clinical maturation after surgery. It does not test a molecular treatment that restores tissue or differentiation.
records.uncertainty: Individual surgical histories do not identify drug efficacy.

records.title: A Scalable Low-Input Redox Proteomics Workflow Enables High-Throughput Analysis of Cysteine Oxidation in 96-Well Cell Cultures.
records.model: RAW264.7 cells in low-input plate assays
records.note: A scalable redox assay reproducibly detects diamide-induced oxidation. The administered compound is a challenge reagent, not a protective agent.
records.uncertainty: No viability or functional rescue result.

records.title: Mechanisms and therapeutic strategies for senescence-associated secretory phenotype in the intervertebral disc degeneration microenvironment.
records.model: Intervertebral-disc senescence literature
records.note: Discusses SASP-driven degeneration and intervention strategies for disc repair. No specific administered agent or measured functional improvement is reported in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: Broad treatment aspiration cannot identify a qualified tissue-compensation route.

records.title: Premature aging in genetic diseases: what conclusions can be drawn for physiological aging.
records.model: HGPS, Werner and Cockayne premature-aging models
records.note: Compares primary damage and downstream aging hallmarks in genetic syndromes. Models are proposed for intervention development; no named administered rescue is given.
records.uncertainty: Aging resemblance does not prove shared therapeutic response.

records.title: Kinetochore-independent mechanisms of sister chromosome separation.
records.model: Drosophila neuroblasts with acentric chromosomes
records.note: Acentric fragments can separate by unconventional microtubule-dependent mechanisms; RNAi identifies factors required for this compensation. No administered drug enhances it.
records.uncertainty: Successful fragment separation is conditional and not whole-genome fidelity evidence.

records.title: Mouse-specific up-regulation of Ccnb1 expression by miR-199a-5p in keratinocyte.
records.model: Mouse keratinocytes with human and monkey cell comparisons
records.note: miR-199a-5p raises mouse Ccnb1 expression and alters phase distribution. Human and monkey CCNB1 expression was unaffected, a direct limit on transferring the protein-availability mechanism.
records.uncertainty: Genetic overexpression, not a demonstrated human restorative medicine.

records.title: Clear-Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Molecular Subtypes Differ by African and European Genetic Similarity.
records.model: Localized clear-cell renal tumors from ancestry-stratified cohorts
records.note: Molecular subtype distributions explain many group-level genomic and transcriptional differences. No intervention tests treatment efficacy.
records.uncertainty: Ancestry associations cannot prescribe a drug response.

records.title: Defining the role of APC in the mitotic spindle checkpoint in vivo: APC-deficient cells are resistant to Taxol.
records.model: APC-deficient intestinal cells and mouse intestinal tumors; Bub1-deleted comparator
records.note: Higher Taxol exposure restored arrest comparable to WT and suppressed intestinal tumorigenesis; Vinorelbine arrest remained intact in APC-deficient cells. This distinguishes lesion-specific microtubule response from a general SAC defect.
records.uncertainty: Need exact exposures and toxicity; restored arrest is not faithful divisions, and APC defects differ from Bub1/BUB1B lesions.

records.title: GLO1 regulates hepatocellular carcinoma proliferation and migration through the cell cycle pathway.
records.model: HCC datasets and cultured cancer cells
records.note: GLO1 expression links to cell-cycle activation and experimentally affects growth/migration. No named administered regulator is supplied.
records.uncertainty: Oxidative-stress biology does not establish antioxidant or tissue-restoration efficacy.

records.title: Lactylation-Driven YTHDC1 Alleviates MASLD by Suppressing PTPN22-Mediated Dephosphorylation of NLRP3.

administered_agents.name: mebendazole
administered_agents.role: drug reported to target YTHDC1 and alleviate MASLD

records.model: MASLD patients/mouse models and hepatocyte YTHDC1 knockout
records.note: Mebendazole reportedly alleviates MASLD in a pathway involving YTHDC1 availability, lactylation and inflammatory signaling. This is a concrete pharmacologic lead beyond expression association.
records.uncertainty: Primary needed for model, exposure, drug effect on YTHDC1 stability, liver-function versus lipid/inflammatory endpoints, and antimitotic harms.

records.title: Dissecting the Genetic and Etiological Causes of Primary Microcephaly.
records.model: Primary microcephaly genetics and neurogenesis
records.note: Reviews cell-cycle and centrosomal defects across microcephaly genes to improve diagnosis. No administered neuronal-production rescue appears.
records.uncertainty: Genetic diagnosis and mechanistic overlap are not treatment evidence.

records.title: Loss of ATRX leads to chromosome cohesion and congression defects.
records.model: ATRX-depleted cultured cells and embryonic mouse neuroprogenitors
records.note: ATRX loss delays metaphase and disrupts cohesion/congression in cells and brain. This helps explain reduced cortical size without demonstrating a corrective agent.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacologic protein-restoration or brain-function rescue.

records.title: The checkpoint protein Zw10 connects CAL1-dependent CENP-A centromeric loading and mitosis duration in Drosophila cells.
records.model: Drosophila cultured centromeres
records.note: CAL1 overexpression increases CENP-A but uncouples its loading from mitosis; Zw10 links loading to checkpoint timing. More centromeric protein is not automatically improved fidelity.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or corrected deficient tissue.

records.title: Comparative transcriptome analysis reveals involvement of FOXL2 in regulation of ovulation cycle in chicken.
records.model: Chicken preovulatory, ovulatory and postovulatory follicles
records.note: FOXL2 networks vary with the ovulation cycle and implicate ECM, DNA replication and senescence. No agent changes ovulation or fertility.
records.uncertainty: Transcriptional association is not functional rescue.

records.title: Lactate metabolism-driven lactylation: paradoxical modulation of intestinal inflammation and malignancy.
records.model: Intestinal inflammation and colorectal-cancer lactylation
records.note: Reviews repair-related inflammatory effects and tumor-promoting effects of lactylation. It supplies explicit context dependence but no specific tested restorative medicine in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: Do not infer uniform benefit from lactate or lactylation modulation.

records.title: The equilibrium of ubiquitination and deubiquitination at PLK1 regulates sister chromatid separation.
records.model: PLK1 kinetochore regulation
records.note: Ubiquitination balance regulates timely PLK1 recruitment and removal. Generic stabilization may not preserve this necessary timing.
records.uncertainty: No administered deubiquitinase/proteasome intervention or measured rescue.

records.title: A perikinetochoric ring defined by MCAK and Aurora-B as a novel centromere domain.
records.model: Mouse spermatocytes in meiosis
records.note: MCAK and Aurora-B form dynamic centromeric domains during meiosis. The study proposes functions from localization rather than testing a therapeutic correction.
records.uncertainty: No named administered agent or fidelity rescue.

records.title: Transcriptomic Analysis of <i>Taar5</i> Expression and Co-Expression Networks in the Cerebellum During Perinatal Development.
records.model: Prenatal and neonatal mouse cerebellum
records.note: Taar5 expression shifts between proliferation, metabolism and glial-marker associations. No receptor ligand or cognitive-developmental rescue was tested.
records.uncertainty: Suggested developmental role remains unvalidated.

records.title: The augmin complex plays a critical role in spindle microtubule generation for mitotic progression and cytokinesis in human cells.
records.model: Human HeLa cells and Drosophila S2 comparison
records.note: Augmin loss impairs spindle generation and cytokinesis; a gamma-TuRC binding-defective mutant fails functional complementation. This is genetic machinery validation rather than a drug route.
records.uncertainty: No administered enhancer of spindle production demonstrated.

records.title: A Cell Biological Perspective on Past, Present and Future Investigations of the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint.
records.model: Spindle assembly checkpoint mechanisms
records.note: Reviews mechanochemical sensing and checkpoint signaling, including remaining questions. No administered agent or restorative endpoint is reported.
records.uncertainty: Checkpoint mechanism knowledge is not a drug trial.

records.title: Aneuploidy causes premature differentiation of neural and intestinal stem cells.
records.model: Drosophila neural and intestinal stem cells; wing-disc comparator
records.note: Aneuploid stem cells leave the cycle and differentiate prematurely, reducing brain size without apoptosis. This warns that cell differentiation or survival alone need not preserve tissue renewal.
records.uncertainty: No administered protective intervention; tissue specificity limits generalization.

records.title: Effect of KNL1 on the proliferation and apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells.
records.model: Colorectal tumor tissues and shRNA-treated cancer cells
records.note: KNL1 silencing inhibits proliferation/colonies and increases apoptosis; tissue expression correlates with BUB1. These are cancer dependency results, not faithful tissue renewal.
records.uncertainty: No administered KNL1 medicine or functional rescue.

records.title: Mechanisms and consequences of aneuploidy and chromosome instability in the aging brain.
records.model: Aging central nervous system aneuploidy
records.note: Discusses abnormal DNA content, mosaicism and neural degeneration, including physiological polyploidy distinctions. No specific intervention is tested.
records.uncertainty: Presence of mosaic aneuploidy does not establish that reducing it restores function.

records.title: Sepsis leads to lasting changes in phenotype and function of memory CD8 T cells.
records.model: Sepsis survivors and LCMV-immune mice after CLP sepsis
records.note: Memory T-cell proliferation restores counts after sepsis while protection against Listeria remains impaired. It is a concrete warning that numerical renewal need not restore useful function.
records.uncertainty: No administered repair agent; this is natural post-sepsis recovery.

records.title: Transcriptional drug repositioning and cheminformatics approach for differentiation therapy of leukaemia cells.
records.model: Leukemia cells
records.note: Fenbendazole at 0.1 micromolar reportedly induces granulocytic differentiation within three days. This is an actual-agent differentiation result rather than merely a computational nomination.
records.uncertainty: Primary needed for cell identity, viability, maturity/function and chromosome effects; leukemia differentiation is not healthy tissue compensation.

records.title: The HIPK2/CDC14B-MeCP2 axis enhances the spindle assembly checkpoint block by promoting cyclin B translation.
records.model: Mitotically arrested cells
records.note: HIPK2/CDC14B-regulated MeCP2 phosphorylation boosts cyclin B1 translation and sustains arrest. Protein availability is functionally connected to reduced slippage, but no administered enhancer is named.
records.uncertainty: Sustained arrest is not successful division; primary pharmacologic identity absent.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes Using Co-Expression Network Analysis in Breast Cancer as a Tool to Predict Different Stages.
records.model: Breast-cancer expression cohorts
records.note: Coexpression identifies mitosis-related prognostic genes and stage associations. It does not test drug action or restoration.
records.uncertainty: Hub-gene nomination is not experimentally established therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Adrenocortical Carcinoma in Childhood: A Systematic Review.
records.model: Pediatric adrenocortical carcinoma case literature
records.note: Summarizes outcomes and resections across retrospective studies without randomized trials or a named candidate regimen. It supplies no specific restorative drug experiment.
records.uncertainty: Multimodal care cannot attribute benefit to an unidentified agent.

records.title: Prediction of carcinogenic potential by a toxicogenomic approach using rat hepatoma cells.
records.model: Rat hepatoma cells exposed to 39 unnamed chemicals
records.note: Gene-expression profiles classify carcinogens after short non-toxic-dose exposures. This is hazard-prediction methodology, not tissue-protective pharmacology.
records.uncertainty: Individual compound identities and long-term functional safety are not supplied.

records.title: Liver cell transformation in chronic HBV infection.
records.model: HBV liver-transformation models
records.note: Discusses viral integration, HBx and inflammation as transformation mechanisms. No administered intervention or normal-liver rescue is described.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic candidate effectors are not tested medicines.

records.title: The necroptosis related gene LGALS3 can be used as a biomarker for the adverse progression from chronic HBV infection to HCC.
records.model: HBV-related liver cohorts and HBV-transfected HUH7/HEPG2 cells
records.note: LGALS3 associates with progression and is knocked down for proliferation/migration experiments. No drug or explicit tissue-function improvement is reported.
records.uncertainty: Abstract does not state the direction of all knockdown functional results.

records.title: PIK3CA copy-number gain and inhibitors of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway in triple-negative breast cancer.

administered_agents.name: everolimus
administered_agents.role: mTOR inhibitor in one clinical case

administered_agents.name: alpelisib
administered_agents.role: PI3K inhibitor in another clinical case

records.model: Two PIK3CA-amplified triple-negative breast-cancer patients
records.note: PET imaging showed disease response to two targeted treatments in separate cases. The evidence concerns cancer response, not copy-number correction or healthy-tissue compensation.
records.uncertainty: Uncontrolled cases and tumor imaging do not establish broader regenerative efficacy.

records.title: Cell Models for Chromosome 20q11.21 Amplification and Drug Sensitivities in Colorectal Cancer.
records.model: Colorectal-cancer cell lines with 20q11.21 amplification
records.note: Database analysis links amplified cancer lines to tyrosine-kinase-inhibitor sensitivity and antimitotic resistance. No named new agent or normalized chromosome state is demonstrated.
records.uncertainty: Drug classes and synthetic-lethality proposals require exact-agent validation.

records.title: Regulation of mitosis and taxane response by Daxx and Rassf1.
records.model: Daxx/Rassf1-perturbed cells, xenografts and breast-cancer patients
records.note: Daxx/Rassf1 depletion stabilizes cyclin B and increases taxol resistance; checkpoint activity can yield micronucleated dying cells. Cancer-drug sensitivity should not be confused with corrected division.
records.uncertainty: Genetic modulation is not a demonstrated safe cyclin-stabilizing therapy.

records.title: The simian immunodeficiency virus targets central cell cycle functions through transcriptional repression in vivo.
records.model: Rhesus macaque T cells during acute SIVmac239 infection
records.note: Infection represses E2F-regulated cell-cycle genes in infected T cells amid broader interferon responses. The study characterizes pathogenesis, not a rescue drug.
records.uncertainty: No protein restoration or immune-function treatment endpoint.

records.title: Alpha-satellite RNA transcripts are repressed by centromere-nucleolus associations.
records.model: Intact human cells and disrupted nucleoli
records.note: Nucleolar disruption increases alpha-satellite transcripts and links nuclear organization to repression. The perturbation agent is not named and no functional rescue is shown.
records.uncertainty: More centromeric RNA is not evidence of improved centromere function.

records.title: Centrosome - a promising anti-cancer target.
records.model: Centrosomal cancer-target literature
records.note: Reviews centrosomal targets and notes some agents have high toxicity with little benefit. No specific administered compound or restorative result is detailed.
records.uncertainty: Unnamed drug classes cannot establish a force-balancing therapeutic window.

records.title: Calreticulin and JAK2V617F driver mutations induce distinct mitotic defects in myeloproliferative neoplasms.
records.model: CALR/JAK2-mutant hematopoietic cells and MPN CD34-positive cells
records.note: Mutant expression causes chromatin segregation errors and imbalanced checkpoint recruitment. Patient cells show reduced mitotic regulators, but no replacement or drug correction is tested.
records.uncertainty: Lower PLK1/Aurora-B/PP2A does not by itself support administering an activator.

records.title: ProTAME Arrest in Mammalian Oocytes and Embryos Does Not Require Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Activity.
records.model: Mammalian oocytes and early cleavage embryos
records.note: ProTAME produces dose-dependent arrest even without SAC activity in these developmental cells. It is an actual SAC-independent pharmacologic metaphase arrest, with no claimed restoration of accurate divisions.
records.uncertainty: Primary needed for SAC manipulation, dose, reversibility, embryo development and chromosome fidelity; arrest alone can block tissue output.

records.title: Histone 2B monoubiquitination complex integrates transcript elongation with RNA processing at circadian clock and flowering regulators.
records.model: Plant HUB/SPEN3/KHD1 mutants
records.note: Mutations alter biomass, flowering, circadian timing and RNA processing. No administered compound or mammalian restorative experiment appears.
records.uncertainty: Plant epigenetic function is not transferable therapeutic efficacy.

records.title: Application of artificial intelligence-based stemness index in cancer.
records.model: AI-derived cancer stemness indices
records.note: Discusses AI-based stemness assessment and treatment personalization. No independently administered treatment or measured differentiation benefit is presented.
records.uncertainty: Prediction quality is not functional drug efficacy.

records.title: p90Rsk is not involved in cytostatic factor arrest in mouse oocytes.
records.model: Mouse embryos and mos-null oocytes with Xenopus comparison
records.note: Active Rsk forms fail to induce embryo arrest or restore MII arrest in mos-null mouse oocytes; triple Rsk knockout retains arrest. This is clear species-specific mechanistic counterevidence.
records.uncertainty: The injected active-mutant delivery material is unspecified in the abstract; this is genetic/protein-mechanism testing, not an identified medicine or successful repair.

records.title: Targeting Lactate and Lactylation in Cancer Metabolism and Immunotherapy.
records.model: Cancer lactate metabolism and immunotherapy
records.note: Reviews lactylation-dependent tumor growth, resistance and immune suppression. No named pharmacologic restoration outcome is provided.
records.uncertainty: Metabolic relevance does not establish a safe tissue-repair route.

records.title: Hidden treasures in "ancient" microarrays: gene-expression portrays biology and potential resistance pathways of major lung cancer subtypes and normal tissue.
records.model: 203 lung-tumor and normal-tissue expression samples
records.note: Reanalysis recovers subtype markers and treatment-related pathways. Normal smooth-muscle contraction pathways are observational, not drug-induced functional recovery.
records.uncertainty: No intervention validation of candidate pathways.

records.title: Clinical and Molecular Characteristics and Outcome of Cystic Partially Differentiated Nephroblastoma and Cystic Nephroma: A Narrative Review of the Literature.
records.model: Children with cystic renal tumors
records.note: Reviews mostly surgical treatment and favorable disease outcomes, including DICER1 associations. It does not identify a medicine restoring function or genomic fidelity.
records.uncertainty: Outcome cannot be attributed to an unspecified drug.

records.title: Phenotype prediction for mucopolysaccharidosis type I by in silico analysis.
records.model: MPS-I IDUA missense variants
records.note: Combines in-silico predictions and structural models to classify enzyme-deficiency variants. No enzyme replacement, chaperone or readthrough treatment is tested.
records.uncertainty: Predicted protein destabilization is not evidence of pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: Unraveling mitotic protein networks by 3D multiplexed epitope drug screening.
records.model: 3D cell spheroids exposed to twelve unnamed mitotic cancer drugs
records.note: 3D SPECS maps drug-dependent spindle and chromatin protein changes. The abstract supplies neither exact drug identities nor a successful restorative endpoint.
records.uncertainty: Predicted protein interactions and expression patterns cannot prove useful tissue output.

records.title: The mutational landscape of the adult healthy parous and nulliparous human breast.
records.model: Healthy parous and nulliparous human breast tissues
records.note: Whole-genome sequencing tracks mutation accumulation and expanded epithelial clones. No intervention reduces mutational load or preserves function.
records.uncertainty: Association with parity does not identify treatment response.

records.title: Chemical dissection of the cell cycle: probes for cell biology and anti-cancer drug development.
records.model: Cancer cells, especially BRAF-mutant melanoma
records.note: MI-181 activates the checkpoint, arrests mitosis and rapidly kills cancer cells. These are explicit cytotoxic outcomes, not cell-cycle fidelity rescue.
records.uncertainty: Broad antitumor activity does not show tolerance in deficient normal tissues.

records.title: LIGHT in combination with IL-13 or IL-17 drives inflammatory transcriptional signatures in human pulmonary fibroblasts relevant for human lung disease.
records.model: Human pulmonary fibroblasts and lung-disease transcript comparisons
records.note: Cytokine combinations induce inflammatory and cell-cycle transcripts matching disease-associated fibroblast subsets. No tissue function or reparative benefit is measured.
records.uncertainty: Cell-cycle induction cannot be assumed to represent healthy regeneration.

records.title: Ubiquitin ligase RNF20/40 facilitates spindle assembly and promotes breast carcinogenesis through stabilizing motor protein Eg5.
records.model: Breast-cancer cells, tumors and RNF20/40-Eg5 pathway
records.note: RNF20/40 stabilizes Eg5 and supports spindle assembly; depletion produces arrest/apoptosis and suppresses cancer. Increased protein availability has tumor-promoting context here.
records.uncertainty: No administered stabilizer or normal-tissue fidelity rescue established.

records.title: Functional and structural impacts of oncogenic missense variants on human polo-like kinase 1 protein.
records.model: PLK1 cancer missense variants and survival datasets
records.note: Models mutation-dependent conformational changes and links PLK1 abundance to prognosis. No compound restores mutant protein structure or activity.
records.uncertainty: Molecular dynamics predictions require functional validation.

records.title: Exploring molecular markers and drug candidates for colorectal cancer through comprehensive bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Colorectal-cancer expression networks
records.note: Bioinformatics nominates unnamed small molecules from coexpression and regulatory networks. No prospective drug administration or rescue is reported.
records.uncertainty: Candidate identities and actual effects are unresolved but no functional positive is claimed.

records.title: Dual recognition of chromatin and microtubules by INCENP is important for mitotic progression.
records.model: Mitotic CPC/INCENP models
records.note: Dual chromatin/microtubule recognition sustains arrest; arrest duration changes death probability. Engineered targeting validates mechanism rather than an administered restorative therapy.
records.uncertainty: Suppressed-microtubule-dynamics agent is unnamed; prolonged arrest does not establish faithful division.

records.title: From metabolic substrate to epigenetic regulation: roles and mechanisms of lactylation in brain health and disease.
records.model: Brain lactate/lactylation in health and disease
records.note: Reviews physiological plasticity and pathological inflammatory/metabolic effects. No named administered treatment or measured cognitive rescue is in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: A mechanistic framework does not identify a beneficial exposure.

records.title: The spatiotemporal dynamics of chromatin protein HP1α is essential for accurate chromosome segregation during cell division.
records.model: Human cell-division HP1alpha localization models
records.note: Persistent chromosome-arm HP1alpha mislocalizes CPC/Sgo1 and impairs attachment and chromatid resolution. It demonstrates why abundance/localization must be timed correctly.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacologic restoration; engineered construct is an adverse mechanistic perturbation.

records.title: Gene structure heterogeneity drives transcription noise within human chromosomes
records.model: Human chromatin simulations validated against omics/imaging
records.note: Model links transcriptional variability to structural heterogeneity and loop extrusion. No agent manipulates a deficient protein or rescues tissue function.
records.uncertainty: Predicted chromatin dynamics are not efficacy evidence; saved record is a preprint.

records.title: Effect of low doses of estradiol and tamoxifen on breast cancer cell karyotypes.
records.model: MCF7, T47D, BT474 and SKBR3 breast-cancer cells
records.note: Both agents increased karyotype complexity; tamoxifen reduced proliferation in some lines while increasing abnormalities. This directly separates growth control from genomic safety.
records.uncertainty: Primary needed to resolve malformed dose typography in the saved abstract, baseline karyotypes, exposure duration and non-tumor relevance.

records.title: A study exploring critical pathways in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Clear-cell renal-carcinoma microarray datasets
records.note: Cross-dataset enrichment identifies immune and other altered pathways. No administered treatment or restorative endpoint is tested.
records.uncertainty: Small-dataset bias and pathway nomination do not prove causality.

records.title: Mouse models in colon cancer, inferences, and implications.
records.model: Colorectal-cancer mouse models
records.note: Discusses model strengths, limitations and needs for immune-competent autochthonous testing. No specific newly administered candidate or tissue-rescue result is provided.
records.uncertainty: General checkpoint-inhibitor discussion is not efficacy evidence for a named agent.

records.title: Detectable clonal mosaicism in the human genome.
records.model: Human clonal mosaicism across apparently healthy populations
records.note: Describes age-related mosaic structural events and possible disease risk. No clearance or chromosome-correction intervention is tested.
records.uncertainty: Clonal frequency changes are not treatment outcomes.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes for Early Diagnosis and Predicting Prognosis in Colon Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Colon-adenocarcinoma gene-expression datasets
records.note: Identifies cell-cycle hub genes with diagnostic/prognostic associations. No drug administration or corrected segregation is described.
records.uncertainty: CENPE/AURKA biomarker roles do not nominate effective inhibitors.

records.title: Malignant Perivascular Epithelioid Cell Tumor (PEComa) of the Uterus as Part of the Hereditary Cancer Syndrome: A Case Diagnosed with Multiple Malignancies.
records.model: Patient with uterine PEComa and multiple malignancies
records.note: Sequencing identifies pathogenic ATM/TP53 variants and a BRCA2 VUS in a Li-Fraumeni case. No therapeutic response or restoration experiment is described.
records.uncertainty: Myogenic marker expression in PEComa is not muscle compensation.

records.title: Immune-related lincRNA pairs predict prognosis and therapeutic response in hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: Liver-cancer lincRNA risk-signature datasets
records.note: A prognostic signature predicts response to immunologic targets and several cytotoxics. Mentioned cisplatin, doxorubicin, mitomycin and vinblastine are predictions rather than administered arms.
records.uncertainty: No observed restorative effect or prospective agent validation.

records.title: Exploring Potential Biomarkers and Molecular Mechanisms of Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Based on Bioinformatics.
records.model: Cutaneous squamous-cell-carcinoma tissues and datasets
records.note: Validates elevated cell-cycle biomarkers and predicts ceRNA networks. No intervention changes their expression or improves tissue output.
records.uncertainty: Diagnostic discrimination is not therapeutic efficacy.

records.title: Characterization of genetic predisposition to molecular subtypes of breast cancer in Brazilian patients.
records.model: 321 Brazilian breast-cancer patients
records.note: A multigene panel expands detection of inherited cancer predisposition beyond BRCA1/2. It evaluates diagnosis and management implications, not treatment effects.
records.uncertainty: Mutation discovery does not establish a corrective medicine.

records.title: Clinical implications of lactylation modification in digestive system tumors (Review).
records.model: Digestive-system tumor lactylation
records.note: Reviews metabolic/epigenetic tumor mechanisms and possible lactylation interventions. No specific administered agent or normal-tissue functional benefit is given.
records.uncertainty: Target class and prognostic models are not validated therapy.

records.title: Telomerase at the intersection of cancer and aging.
records.model: Telomerase in aging and cancer
records.note: Reviews telomerase effects on telomeres, metabolic fitness and Wnt alongside tumor biology. No named activator or measured age-related functional rescue is supplied.
records.uncertainty: Therapeutic-target language cannot identify an administered agent or establish safe activation.

records.title: Functional analysis of the transcription repressor PLU-1/JARID1B.
records.model: Human mammary epithelial cells
records.note: PLU-1/JARID1B overexpression represses BRCA1 and mitotic genes and impairs G2/M control; silencing alters chromatin marks. No inhibitor restores deficient protein function in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: Expression changes do not demonstrate completed accurate divisions.

records.title: Identification of post-transcriptional regulatory networks during myeloblast-to-monocyte differentiation transition.
records.model: Leukemia cells and differentiated monocytic counterparts
records.note: Treatment-associated myeloblast-to-monocyte transition is linked to ribosome-bound RNA and PLK1 regulatory networks. This is a named-agent differentiation lead beyond static expression association.
records.uncertainty: Need primary confirmation of differentiation extent, cell function, viability and exposure; not demonstrated healthy-muscle or immune restoration.

records.title: Key candidate genes and pathways in T lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma identified by bioinformatics and serological analyses.
records.model: T-ALL/T-LBL patient samples and public expression data
records.note: Differential genes and blood markers characterize disease and immune defects. Folate/EPO levels are measured markers, not administered treatment arms.
records.uncertainty: No medication-driven normalization or functional rescue.

records.title: Ten hub genes associated with progression and prognosis of pancreatic carcinoma identified by co-expression analysis.
records.model: Pancreatic-cancer expression and protein databases
records.note: Cell-cycle hubs associate with grade, progression and prognosis. No inhibition or protein-availability intervention is tested.
records.uncertainty: Expression of UBE2C/TPX2 does not prove therapeutic target efficacy.

records.title: BAP1 loss induces mitotic defects in mesothelioma cells through BRCA1-dependent and independent mechanisms
records.model: BAP1-deficient mesothelioma cells and tumor samples
records.note: BAP1 loss destabilizes BRCA1 and reduces KIF18A/B; re-expression of the kinesins rescues spindle/astral defects. This is a selective genetic rescue, not an administered proteasome or kinesin medicine.
records.uncertainty: Saved preprint abstract names no stabilizing drug; rescued structures do not establish all segregation defects corrected.

records.title: Mutations in the chromosomal passenger complex and the condensin complex differentially affect synaptonemal complex disassembly and metaphase I configuration in Drosophila female meiosis.
records.model: Drosophila female meiosis and maternal-effect embryos
records.note: Condensin/INCENP mutants disrupt distinct meiotic processes and cause early embryonic lethality. No agent or successful correction is tested.
records.uncertainty: Genetic interactions do not supply a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Human genome sequencing in health and disease.
records.model: Human whole-genome and exome clinical implementation
records.note: Reviews genome sequencing for disease diagnosis and possible adjuvant therapy suggestions. No exact intervention or functional response is given.
records.uncertainty: Genomic utility does not equal efficacy of inferred treatment.

records.title: Centrosome amplification induced by DNA damage occurs during a prolonged G2 phase and involves ATM.
records.model: Rad51/Rad54-deficient and DNA-damaged cells with ATM genetics
records.note: Both compounds reduce damage-induced centrosome amplification by shortening or overriding the checkpoint state. A better-looking centrosome count need not mean less DNA damage or faithful divisions.
records.uncertainty: Primary required for agent specificity, damage burden, completed segregation and survival; do not equate checkpoint escape with restoration.

records.title: INK4 cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors as potential prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma datasets and clinical samples
records.note: INK4-family proteins are measured as endogenous prognostic and immune-associated genes. They are not administered CDK-inhibitor drugs in this study.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacologic treatment, corrected checkpoint or useful tissue output.

records.title: Non-Coding RNAs Are Brokers in Breast Cancer Interactome Networks and Add Discrimination Power between Subtypes.
records.model: Breast-cancer transcriptomic subtypes
records.note: Network removal of ncRNA nodes improves subtype characterization in silico. Computational removal is not biological depletion or administered treatment.
records.uncertainty: No experimentally validated functional rescue.

records.title: The microtubule-associated protein EML3 regulates mitotic spindle assembly by recruiting the Augmin complex to spindle microtubules.
records.model: EML3-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: WT or phosphomimetic EML3 restores Augmin/gamma-TuRC localization and spindle assembly after knockdown. The successful intervention is exogenous genetic complementation.
records.uncertainty: No administered CDK1 activator or EML3 medicine; structural rescue does not prove full fidelity.

records.title: A unique binding mode of Nek2A to the APC/C allows its ubiquitination during prometaphase.
records.model: APC/C-MCC and Nek2A with cellular studies
records.note: Explains how Nek2A can be ubiquitinated despite checkpoint inhibition of other APC/C substrates. No pharmacologic manipulation or deficient-tissue rescue is tested.
records.uncertainty: Substrate specificity limits inference from general APC/C blockade.

records.title: The Genomic and Immune Landscapes of Lethal Metastatic Breast Cancer.
records.model: Metastases from ten therapy-resistant breast-cancer patients
records.note: Profiles clonal evolution, neoantigens and HLA loss in lethal disease. Treatment resistance is background, with no named intervention response tested here.
records.uncertainty: Autopsy associations do not identify a restorative candidate.

records.title: The Interplay of Vitamin D Deficiency and Cellular Senescence in The Pathogenesis of Obesity-Related Co-Morbidities.
records.model: Obesity, vitamin-D deficiency, senescence and metabolic disease
records.note: Reviews relationships among deficiency, senescence, atherosclerosis and fatty liver. Vitamin D is not reported as an administered beneficial treatment in this abstract.
records.uncertainty: Association with deficiency does not prove supplementation restores tissue function.

records.title: RABL6A promotes G1-S phase progression and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor cell proliferation in an Rb1-dependent manner.
records.model: BON-1 pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor cells
records.note: Rb1 inactivation partly restores G1/S progression after RABL6A loss but fails to overcome mitotic arrest or death. This is explicit evidence that partial cycle recovery need not restore viable output.
records.uncertainty: Genetic tumor-cell epistasis, not a pharmacologic restoration strategy.

records.title: Proteomics Reveals the Response Mechanism of Embryonic Bovine Lung Cells to Mycoplasma bovis Infection.
records.model: Embryonic bovine lung cells
records.note: Infection reduced antioxidant capacity and mitochondrial potential while increasing apoptosis; proteomics implicated growth and stress pathways. No restorative agent was tested.
records.uncertainty: Pathway enrichment does not establish a drug response.

records.title: Senescent Cell Depletion Through Targeting BCL-Family Proteins and Mitochondria.
records.model: Review of senescent cells and reporter-mouse systems
records.note: The review discusses BCL blockade and mitochondrial targeting to eliminate senescent cells; MitoTam is presented as a complex-I-directed senolytic. This is depletion rather than restoration of deficient cells.
records.uncertainty: Original treatment studies, functional benefits and tissue liabilities require primary-source attribution; the abstract does not supply those comparisons.

records.title: Molecular Guardians of Oocyte Maturation: A Systematic Review on TUBB8, KIF11, and CKAP5 in IVF Outcomes.
records.model: Infertility patients with TUBB8, KIF11 or CKAP5 variants and functional models
records.note: Variants were linked to spindle defects and reproductive failure; donor-oocyte IVF is described as the effective alternative. No administered pharmacologic rescue was reported.
records.uncertainty: Gene-therapy rescue is prospective, and reproductive tissue results do not establish muscle compensation.

records.title: Clinical trio genome sequencing facilitates the interpretation of variants in cancer predisposition genes in paediatric tumour patients.
records.model: 72 pediatric solid-tumor patients and their parents
records.note: Trio sequencing identified cancer-predisposition variants and clarified inheritance and structural variation. The measured utility is diagnostic characterization.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic agent or restorative outcome was assessed.

records.title: TopoIIα prevents telomere fragility and formation of ultra thin DNA bridges during mitosis through TRF1-dependent binding to telomeres.
records.model: TRF1-deficient and TopoIIalpha-downregulated cellular models
records.note: Loss of telomeric TRF1 or TopoIIalpha was associated with fragile telomeres, ultrafine bridges and delayed mitosis. The study supports maintenance of telomere replication machinery.
records.uncertainty: The abstract names no administered intervention that reverses these defects.

records.title: Preimplantation chromosomal mosaics, chimaeras and confined placental mosaicism.
records.model: Human and animal embryonic/placental mosaicism
records.note: The review considers elimination, selection and possible correction of abnormal embryonic cells, with chromosome-dependent confinement to placenta. It does not test a treatment.
records.uncertainty: Natural depletion of abnormal cells cannot be credited to a pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: The Mitotic Checkpoint Complex controls the association of Cdc20 regulatory protein with the ubiquitin ligase APC/C in mitosis.
records.model: APC/C-Cdc20-MCC mitotic regulatory system
records.note: MCC stabilizes APC/C-associated Cdc20 despite phosphorylation and limits its autoubiquitylation/release. This clarifies regulation of anaphase timing.
records.uncertainty: No actual drug or tissue-level rescue is specified.

records.title: Drosophila Ajuba is not an Aurora-A activator but is required to maintain Aurora-A at the centrosome.
records.model: Drosophila jub-mutant neural stem cells
records.note: Jub deficiency displaced active Aurora-A from centrosomes and disrupted spindle formation without abolishing kinase activity. The finding distinguishes localization from abundance or catalytic activation.
records.uncertainty: No administered rescue or mammalian disease benefit was reported.

records.title: Mitotic activity of survivin is regulated by acetylation at K129.
records.model: Survivin K129 substitution cell models
records.note: Both acetyl-mimetic and non-acetylatable survivin substitutions impaired mitotic exit; static modification did not substitute for cycling acetylation.
records.uncertainty: No acetylation-modulating drug or restorative treatment was tested.

records.title: Purification of kinetochores from the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
records.model: Budding-yeast purified kinetochores
records.note: The article presents kinetochore purification for reconstituting microtubule attachments and dissecting forces and checkpoint components.
records.uncertainty: An assay method is not evidence of therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Selective blockade of cancer cell proliferation and anchorage-independent growth by Plk1 activity-dependent suicidal inhibition of its polo-box domain.
records.model: Cancer and normal-cell comparisons
records.note: Expressed PBIPtide blocked Plk1 polo-box interactions, inducing cancer-cell mitotic arrest, apoptosis and reduced anchorage-independent growth.
records.uncertainty: Expression of a peptide is not established drug delivery; selective tumor killing does not demonstrate tissue restoration.

records.title: Significant obesity-associated gene expression changes occur in the stomach but not intestines in obese mice.
records.model: ob/ob and high-fat-fed obese mice versus lean controls
records.note: Stomach transcriptional changes exceeded intestinal changes in two obesity models, including a suggested gastrin/acid-secretion program.
records.uncertainty: No administered corrective agent or measured restoration of whole-body metabolism was reported.

records.title: The PITSLRE/CDK11p58 protein kinase promotes centrosome maturation and bipolar spindle formation.
records.model: CDK11 RNAi and isoform-expression cellular models
records.note: CDK11 depletion impaired centrosome maturation and bipolar spindles; CDK11p58, unlike p110, rescued the RNAi phenotype. This is a specific genetic complementation result.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacologic induction of the rescuing isoform or disease-model functional benefit was tested.

records.title: Prognostic utility of the breast cancer index and comparison to Adjuvant! Online in a clinical case series of early breast cancer.
records.model: 265 ER-positive node-negative breast-cancer patients
records.note: BCI scores stratified recurrence and mortality in treated patients and added predictive information to a clinical risk tool.
records.uncertainty: The study evaluates prognostic discrimination, not a randomized tamoxifen effect or tissue rescue.

records.title: Metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk in latent autoimmune diabetes in adults: potential roles of lactate-induced histone lactylation in immune regulation and pancreatic β-cell fate.
records.model: LADA and adjacent diabetes/immune literature
records.note: The review explicitly distinguishes lactylation hypotheses from direct LADA evidence and identifies missing disease-specific validation.
records.uncertainty: No actual lactate intervention or beta-cell rescue is established by this abstract.

records.title: Exploring lactylation and cancer biology: insights from pathogenesis to clinical applications.
records.model: Cancer lactylation and tumor-microenvironment literature
records.note: The review links lactylation to gene regulation, immune-state transitions and tumor progression while describing unresolved therapeutic questions.
records.uncertainty: No named administered intervention or functional restorative comparison is supplied.

records.title: Constitutional aneuploidy and cancer predisposition.
records.model: Constitutional aneuploidy syndromes and cancer risk
records.note: The review relates constitutional chromosome-number syndromes to cancer predisposition and possible mechanisms.
records.uncertainty: No intervention or rescue experiment is described.

records.title: The Molecular Pathology of Blood Cancer: A Comprehensive Review of Chromosome and Genetic Abnormalities and Their Clinical Utility.
records.model: Hematologic malignancies and molecular diagnostics
records.note: The review surveys genetic abnormalities, prognostic classification and targeted-treatment concepts in blood cancers.
records.uncertainty: Tyrosine-kinase inhibitors are discussed only as a class; no named rescue candidate or qualifying comparison is given.

records.title: The protein composition of mitotic chromosomes determined using multiclassifier combinatorial proteomics.
records.model: Isolated mitotic chromosomes and Ska3/Rama1 knockouts
records.note: Proteomic classifiers identified chromosome-associated proteins; loss of Ska disrupted stable chromosome association of APC/C and RanBP2/RanGAP1.
records.uncertainty: Identification and localization changes do not show administered-agent rescue.

records.title: Nocodazole-Induced Expression and Phosphorylation of Anillin and Other Mitotic Proteins Are Decreased in DNA-Dependent Protein Kinase Catalytic Subunit-Deficient Cells and Rescued by Inhibition of the Anaphase-Promoting Complex/Cyclosome with proTAME but Not Apcin.
records.model: DNA-PKcs-deleted HeLa and A549 cells
records.note: proTAME restored nocodazole-induced cyclin B1, anillin and securin expression and several mitotic phosphorylation signals in deficient cells. The title distinguishes this from Apcin nonrescue.
records.uncertainty: Primary details are needed for exact comparator evidence, timing, and whether spindle defects or faithful segregation improve; abstract rescue is biochemical, not tissue function.

records.title: Integrated Analysis of WES and scRNA-Seq Data Reveals the Genetic Basis of Immune Dysregulation in Unexplained Recurrent Pregnancy Loss.
records.model: 13 recurrent-pregnancy-loss patients plus decidual single-cell data
records.note: Variant and transcriptomic analyses linked recurrent loss with lipid/immune dysregulation and lower heat-shock-protein expression.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic language exceeds a demonstrated intervention; no heat-shock restoration treatment was tested.

records.title: Sensing centromere tension: Aurora B and the regulation of kinetochore function.
records.model: Aurora-B-regulated kinetochore tension and attachments
records.note: The review explains tension-dependent correction of attachments and spatial control of Aurora-B substrates.
records.uncertainty: No administered compound or functional rescue comparison is specified.

records.title: Lateral attachment of kinetochores to microtubules is enriched in prometaphase rosette and facilitates chromosome alignment and bi-orientation establishment.
records.model: Prometaphase kinetochore/microtubule attachment models
records.note: Lateral attachments and rosette formation helped establish alignment and biorientation; perturbations revealed compensation between motor and depolymerization movements.
records.uncertainty: The abstract supplies no named administered rescue agent, despite involvement of Aurora-B activity and motor proteins.

records.title: Microtubule attachment and spindle assembly checkpoint signalling at the kinetochore.
records.model: Kinetochore attachment and SAC signaling
records.note: The review integrates kinase/phosphatase signaling with KMN-mediated attachments and checkpoint activation.
records.uncertainty: No actual therapeutic intervention or measured restoration is presented.

records.title: Phosphorylation of the Ndc80 complex protein, HEC1, by Nek2 kinase modulates chromosome alignment and signaling of the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Hec1-depleted cells expressing S165 mutants
records.note: Nonphosphorylatable Hec1 accelerated anaphase with segregation errors, while the phosphomimetic impaired alignment and prolonged arrest. This argues for regulated cycling rather than a uniformly beneficial phosphorylation direction.
records.uncertainty: No administered Nek2/PP1 modulator or demonstrated drug rescue is named.

records.title: Transcriptomic analysis reinforces the implication of spatacsin in neuroinflammation and neurodevelopment.
records.model: Spg11-null and wild-type mouse brain regions at three ages
records.note: Spatacsin loss altered inflammatory, RNA and neuronal-development programs, including early proliferation-related pathways.
records.uncertainty: No treatment restored motor-neuron function or the transcriptome.

records.title: Modular Hub Genes in DNA Microarray Suggest Potential Signaling Pathway Interconnectivity in Various Glioma Grades.
records.model: Public glioma microarray datasets and gene-network analysis
records.note: Norgestimate and ethisterone were computationally ranked from gene-expression signatures. The abstract proposes progesterone-linked neuroprotection without an administered-agent experiment.
records.uncertainty: Neither glioma response nor protection of normal neurons was measured for the nominated drugs.

records.title: Identification and Validation in a Novel Classification of Helicase Patterns for the Prediction of Tumor Proliferation and Prognosis.
records.model: TCGA HCC cohort, single-cell data and tissue staining
records.note: Helicase-expression clusters and DDX56 staining tracked proliferation and adverse prognosis.
records.uncertainty: No helicase-targeting drug or restorative intervention was tested.

records.title: Age-Specific Gene Expression Profiles of Rhesus Monkey Ovaries Detected by Microarray Analysis.
records.model: Young, middle-aged and old rhesus-monkey ovaries
records.note: Old ovaries showed broad changes in cell-cycle, repair and reproductive expression programs.
records.uncertainty: An age-associated expression signature is not evidence of an effective ovarian or muscle treatment.

records.title: Protein arginine methylation: an emerging regulator of the cell cycle.
records.model: PRMT and cell-cycle/DNA-repair literature
records.note: Arginine methylation is reviewed as a regulator of cell-cycle proteins and a potential cancer target.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered PRMT agent or rescue outcome is provided.

records.title: The role of Golgi complex proteins in cell division and consequences of their dysregulation.
records.model: Golgi-localized proteins, division models and TCGA data
records.note: The article links Golgi proteins to spindle organization, differentiation and cancer-associated expression changes.
records.uncertainty: No administered restorative agent or functional intervention comparison is described.

records.title: mTORC1 and p53: clash of the gods?

administered_agents.name: rapamycin
administered_agents.role: reviewed mTORC1 inhibitor, no new administration reported

records.model: p53-mTORC1 growth/stress literature
records.note: The review frames growth promotion and DNA-damage restraint as interacting requirements and discusses possible implications of mTORC1 inhibition.
records.uncertainty: It does not supply a rapamycin efficacy experiment; growth suppression and genome maintenance cannot be assumed equivalent.

records.title: Distinct Roles of NANOS1 and NANOS3 in the Cell Cycle and NANOS3-PUM1-FOXM1 Axis to Control G2/M Phase in a Human Primordial Germ Cell Model.
records.model: TCam-2 primordial-germ-cell model and testis-cancer datasets
records.note: NANOS1 and NANOS3 overexpression suppressed different cell-cycle gene pools; NANOS3/PUM1 repressed FOXM1 RNA.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or improved reproductive function was tested.

records.title: Aging-Induced Stem Cell Mutations as Drivers for Disease and Cancer.
