records.title: Rhabdomyosarcomas: an overview on the experimental animal models.
records.model: Experimental rhabdomyosarcoma animal models
records.note: The review surveys carcinogen, radiation and genetic models of malignant muscle-lineage progenitors.
records.uncertainty: Muscle-lineage tumor biology does not establish skeletal-muscle compensation; no specific rescue agent is named.

records.title: GPS-ARM: computational analysis of the APC/C recognition motif by predicting D-boxes and KEN-boxes.
records.model: Human APC/C recognition motifs and predicted substrates
records.note: GPS-ARM predicted D-box/KEN-box motifs and candidate APC/C substrates for experimental follow-up.
records.uncertainty: Prediction of a degradation signal is not a demonstrated protein-stabilizing drug or functional rescue.

records.title: Kinesins in Cancer Drug Resistance: Mechanisms, Therapeutic Targeting, and Translational Potential.
records.model: Kinesin-related cancer resistance literature
records.note: The review discusses direct inhibitors and combination strategies while explicitly cautioning that expression does not establish dependency.
records.uncertainty: No individual administered compound or new functional-rescue comparison is described in the abstract.

records.title: Basal aurora kinase B activity is sufficient for histone H3 phosphorylation in prophase.
records.model: Mitotic cell imaging and histone-phosphorylation assays
records.note: C4-treated cells progressed through mitosis despite early H3 dephosphorylation but developed lagging chromosomes and prolonged division. Other Aurora inhibitors reproduced defects at reduced concentrations.
records.uncertainty: Primary text is needed for full C4 and comparator identities, selectivity and exposure; cell-cycle progression is not evidence of repaired fidelity.

records.title: Functional requirements of protein kinases and phosphatases in the development of the Drosophila melanogaster wing.
records.model: Drosophila wing kinases/phosphatases and receptor-pathway modifiers
records.note: The work screens kinase/phosphatase functions in intact wings and interactions with growth-factor and insulin signaling.
records.uncertainty: No named administered kinase drug or restored developmental function is described.

records.title: Disruption of ruminal homeostasis by malnutrition involved in systemic ruminal microbiota-host interactions in a pregnant sheep model.
records.model: Sixteen pregnant ewes randomized to severe feed restriction or normal feeding
records.note: Severe restriction altered rumen microbes and metabolism and reduced papillary dimensions and epithelial proliferation. This is direct tissue-level harm from undernutrition.
records.uncertainty: No nutritional repletion or defined supplement rescue was tested; ruminal effects are not measured skeletal-muscle benefit.

records.title: Key genes involved in cell cycle arrest and DNA damage repair identified in anaplastic thyroid carcinoma using integrated bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Anaplastic-thyroid-carcinoma expression datasets
records.note: Cell-cycle and repair genes were nominated, and database inhibitors of CHEK1/CDK1/TOP2A were identified.
records.uncertainty: No named drug administration or measured tumor, fidelity or tissue rescue is provided.

records.title: Genomic data mining reveals hub genes and lncRNAs as prognostic biomarkers in breast cancer.
records.model: Breast-cancer expression and survival datasets
records.note: Coexpression and survival analyses nominated lncRNA biomarkers for later biological validation.
records.uncertainty: No lncRNA-targeting therapeutic or functional rescue experiment was done.

records.title: Oocyte-specific deletion of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5 causes apoptosis of mouse oocytes within the early-growing follicles by mitochondrial fission defect-reactive oxygen species-DNA damage.
records.model: Eif5 conditional-knockout mouse oocytes and follicles
records.note: Eif5 loss reduced fission-related proteins, activated stress/damage responses and caused mitochondrial dysfunction and oocyte apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: Potential targets are proposed, but no ISR-modulating, antioxidant or protein-restoring agent was tested.

records.title: Structure-biological function relationship extended to mitotic arrest-deficient 2-like protein Mad2 native and mutants-new opportunity for genetic disorder control.
records.model: Published Mad2 mutants and designed in-silico variants
records.note: QSAR models related Mad2 structural features to binding/conversion and designed possible chromosome-instability-promoting mutants.
records.uncertainty: No administered small molecule or experimentally corrected segregation is demonstrated.

records.title: Bulk RNA Sequencing Reveals Signature Differences in Key Cell Signaling Pathways Between Porcine Venous and Arterial Smooth Muscle Cells.
records.model: Porcine venous versus arterial smooth-muscle cells
records.note: The two vascular cell types showed distinct cell-cycle and structural transcriptional programs, motivating subtype-specific hypotheses.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic intervention or smooth/skeletal-muscle function improvement was tested.

records.title: Discovery of novel antimyeloma agents targeting TRIP13 by molecular modeling and bioassay.
records.model: Multiple-myeloma cells, ATPase assays and molecular modeling
records.note: F368-0183 suppressed NCI-H929 proliferation and engaged TRIP13 by a thermal-shift assay; the hit set inhibited ATPase activity, with residual selectivity uncertainty.
records.uncertainty: Tumor growth inhibition and target engagement do not establish corrected checkpoint fidelity or tissue compensation; four identities are absent from the abstract.

integration_refinements.reason: Independent rereading distinguishes SAC-independent arrest from checkpoint override or mitotic escape. Original part-file hash is retained.
integration_refinements.original_note: ProTAME produces dose-dependent arrest even without SAC activity in these developmental cells. It is an actual pharmacologic checkpoint-bypass mechanism, with no claimed restoration of accurate divisions.
integration_refinements.final_note: ProTAME produces dose-dependent arrest even without SAC activity in these developmental cells. It is an actual SAC-independent pharmacologic metaphase arrest, with no claimed restoration of accurate divisions.
